entities.summary: Major General Horatio Gordon Robley was a British soldier who served in New Zealand, Mauritius, South Africa and Ceylon, then parts of the British Empire. He made drawings of Māori people and Māori culture and collected Māori items including almost three dozen Mokomokai, or heads of deceased Māori men.
